title: 全球资本涌向AI少数巨头 循环流动加剧市场失衡
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Global capital flows, it's just a nerdy way of saying the money that flows around the world.
segments.zh: 全球资本流动，说白了就是资金在世界各地流转。

segments.en: And, directionally, it does tend to be wherever investors expect the greatest return, which right now, pretty much means one thing.
segments.zh: 从方向上看，资金总是流向回报预期最高的地方，眼下几乎只有一个方向。

segments.en: An extraordinary amount of capital has flowed into a tiny number of powerful, predominantly American hands.
segments.zh: 大量资金涌入了极少数实力雄厚的机构手中，且以美国为主。

segments.en: It's pulling in a lot of investments from all of the world.
segments.zh: 它正从全球各地吸引大量配置。

segments.en: In fact, foreign investors now count for 20% of all US equity holdings.
segments.zh: 事实上，海外市场参与者目前占美国权益资产总持有量的20%。

segments.en: The AI revolution isn't going to come cheap.
The more money AI draws, the less is available to other industries and countries.
segments.zh: AI吸引的资金越多，其他行业和国家可用的资金就越少。

segments.en: What people get worried about is the imbalances in these flows, and that's where you have kind of potential vulnerabilities in the system.
segments.zh: 人们担心的是这些流动的失衡，这正是系统中潜在脆弱性的来源。

segments.en: For the better payoff, the biggest tech giants need to deliver strong returns.
segments.zh: 为了获得更好回报，科技巨头需要交出强劲的业绩。

segments.en: And if they don't, that pipeline could suddenly become a drain.
segments.zh: 如果做不到，这条管道可能突然变成拖累。

segments.en: In the world of AI, a circular deal often refers to transactions between customers and their suppliers.
segments.zh: 在AI领域，循环交易通常指客户与供应商之间的交易。

segments.en: For us, as economists, we're taking a larger view.
segments.zh: 作为经济学家，我们看得更宏观。
